The previous attempt's failure was that page=4, size=2 gave [7] instead of [] — with one-based indexing, page 4 starts at index 6, and range(1,8) has 7 elements (indices 0..6), so items[6:8] = [7]. The issue says 'return [] beyond the last page'; page 4 with size 2 covers items 7-8, but only item 7 exists, so it is the last (partial) page, not beyond it. The correct 'beyond last page' test is page=5 (start index 8, beyond the 7 elements).
